reviews.title: Still a great GPU for 1440p gaming, always will be
reviews.comment:
I’ve been using the RTX 3070 for a long while now and it’s been a very solid card overall. Performance is excellent for 1440p gaming, most modern titles run smoothly on high or ultra settings, and DLSS makes a noticeable difference. When overclocked it can tackle 4k gaming although certainly best in 1440p. Ray tracing and shadows work decent too when paired with DLSS, but Its definitely a much better experience when cutting back on lighting/shadows.
Thermals and power efficiency are both reasonable for the performance level, and the card remains stable with no crashes or weird behavior. It’s also a good size for most cases and wont require any special setup beyond the usual driver install.
While it’s definitely not a new generation anymore, the 3070 still holds up very well and feels like a great balance of performance, features, and reliability at a excellent price. Looks great in almost any case as well. If you’re upgrading from an older GPU, this is a noticeable step up and still very capable for today’s games and everyday use, very hard to beat the speed for this price.

reviews.title: Good upgrade from a 1060
reviews.comment: Replaced a 1060 hybrid cooling with this one. I don't push it hard, but I have noticed no changes in noise levels or Temps. Noticeable improvement in game play, but im just playing Baulders Gate and GTA 5 on a 1440 monitor.

reviews.title: Its an RTX. Its good.
reviews.comment: Love the card. Works as it should. The only issue i have is my own. I was hoping to be a little closer to 240 fps with 240hz monitor and have a bit more stable frames while streaming apex legends on twitch. Which is certainly asking for a lot. But in BR it has huge swings from 140-240fps (even while not streaming it will). Meaning i need an even more powerful card than this one to get the job I personally want done. If you're looking to hold 240fps while streaming and sometimes recording. You'll need to go a step above this card!

reviews.title: Product nearly killed my computer; partial refund only.
reviews.comment:
After I installed this card into my build I started having my display randomly go black, forcing a restart. This also happened during stress tests, making it impossible to get into a game with decent graphics.
Tried various methods to fix it (updating drivers, undervolting, underclocking, etc.) but none worked. Eventually, my computer booted up into recovery mode after trying to restart to fix the black screen. Had I not created a restore point, I would’ve lost everything on my computer.
I send it back, wanting compensation for the half-baked gpu I received, but the company withheld 90 dollars from my reimbursement over a “restocking fee.” If you look into this company’s return policy, you’ll see they basically determine whether or not they have to even give you a payout. It’s no better than a scam.
Please buy your card from another seller, unless you want to brick your system.
